This label is a complete equivalent.

candidate_relations.reason: PSVT denotes a paroxysmal reentrant tachycardia with abrupt onset/offset. The ECG here shows nonparoxysmal accelerated junctional rhythm with isorhythmic AV dissociation and varying PR intervals, which is mechanistically and clinically distinct from PSVT.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: PSVT implies a reentrant paroxysmal mechanism; the arrhythmia here is nonparoxysmal with isorhythmic AV dissociation, incompatible with PSVT

candidate_relations.reason: AVNRT would show retrograde P waves with a fixed short RP interval, not independent P waves at a similar rate with varying PR intervals and cannon waves. The ECG findings are incompatible with AVNRT.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: AVNRT is a reentrant tachycardia with retrograde P waves and fixed RP relationship; the ECG here shows AV dissociation with independent P waves marching through QRS at similar rates
